applies_why: The judge text resolves a chain collision over Isaiah 7:14 by noting each side’s answer, so K-C’s chain-weighing requirement governs.
quote: D5 vs C5 (Isaiah 7:14): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the virgin and young-woman wording in [DR3] and defender answered the prophetic application in [CR2] and [CR3].
rule_words: When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.
room: the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse: whether underdetermined after noting each side’s answer is chain-footing weighing, or whether it is impermissible splitting into isolated points
why: The judge records the challenger’s wording answer and the defender’s application answer and leaves the link underdetermined without invoking the retired stating-verse test, which is consistent with chain-level weighing.
